info.title: Job Board API
info.description: MongoDB backend. Bearer access tokens plus rotating HttpOnly refresh cookie. Signup returns no access token or cookie. Email verification is required before login and all authenticated requests. Administrative mutations require a login within the last 15 minutes. See docs/authentication.md and docs/backend-release.md.

RefreshCookie.name: jobboard_refresh
RefreshCookie.description: Production cookie is named __Secure-jobboard_refresh; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production.

Register.description: Employer registration also requires company_name. Passwords are limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes.

CreateJob.description: Maximum salary must be at least minimum. Deadline must be future ISO/null. New jobs await moderation.

UpdateJob.description: At least one field is required; merged salary range is checked and content edits resubmit review.
